details: Characteristic-zero instance of Yang's VC bound.
proof: A shattered set of size d induces the boundary of a d-dimensional cross-polytope in the Yang complex. Its top reduced homology is nonzero over $\mathbb Q$, so Hochster's formula gives $\mathrm{Y}_0(\mathcal H)\geq d$. Maximize over shattered sets.
name: Characteristic-zero Yang Dimension / VC Dimension
